thread:
Maya (eng-platform): Heads up — we need to finalize the minimal SDK header contract for region/tier routing and fallback control. Meeting tomorrow but want quick alignment here first.

Otto (eng-runtime): +1. Current ad-hoc headers are messy. What's the minimal set we actually need from clients?

Maya (eng-platform): My proposal: a single header that can carry structured hints, e.g.:
```
X-Redwood-Route: region=eu-west-1;tier=premium;fallback=variant:quant8;allow_override=false;debug=route-trace
```
We parse it server-side into policy hints. Keep per-request fields small.

Zara (product): From a UX/enterprise POV customers want the ability to prefer region and tier but not override server fallbacks. Also need clear telemetry so console can show why a request went to a fallback variant.

Eli (devex): SDKs should expose high-level flags (regionHint, tierHint, debugOptions) and translate them into header. Avoid making customers construct header strings.

Jin (eng-telemetry): Telemetry fields we need (per-request): route.hint_region, route.hint_tier, route.chosen_region, route.chosen_variant, route.fallback_reason, route.penalty_ms. If the client sends debug=route-trace, include route path in logs but restrict retention.

Otto (eng-runtime): Two runtime constraints to call out: 1) we cannot honor tier overrides beyond customer's SLA entitlement (security/abuse), 2) variant fallback should prefer same-region compatible quantization to avoid cross-region latency.

Maya (eng-platform): Agreed on 1. Proposal: if header contains tier=*, runtime will clamp to the account's max_tier and emit route.fallback_reason=clamped_tier in telemetry. We should also return a response header that indicates final routing for quick client introspection, e.g.:
```
X-Redwood-Routed: region=us-east-1;variant=cpu_opt_v1;tier=standard;reason=clamped_tier
```

Zara (product): That response header is great for debugging flows in the console and for customers to surface in their logs. Make sure we don't expose sensitive internals in that header. Keep short key/value pairs.

Eli (devex): A couple SDK concerns: 1) How to represent 'allow_override' vs 'force' semantics in SDKs (boolean vs enum)? 2) Should debug flag be gated behind an API key permission so we don't flood prod traces?

Maya (eng-platform): For 1, use an enum: {prefer, require, forbid}. For 2, yes — debug=route-trace should only be allowed if token scope includes 'trace:route' or if in a dev sandbox. We'll return 403-like routing denial header when denied.

Otto (eng-runtime): Implementation note: header parsing must be forward-compatible. Use semicolon-delimited k=v pairs, unknown keys ignored. Also support a compact base64 JSON hint for future extensibility but keep SDKs using the simple format for now.

Jin (eng-telemetry): On telemetry retention and PII: route tracing should not log full prompt or embeddings, only the route decision and timing. Add event tag: route.trace_tag to link to request id for short-term debugging.

Maya (eng-platform): Quotas interplay: If a preferred tier is requested but account lacks quota, runtime should fallback to lower tier and set route.fallback_reason=quota_exhausted. That needs to appear in metrics so console can surface it in per-route dashboards.

Zara (product): Dashboard UX ask: show a small badge on per-route views when >1% requests were clamped/fallbacked, and allow filter by fallback_reason. Also allow drill-to-request for last 50 route traces (if permitted).

Eli (devex): SDK change: expose a helper to turn on 'silent' mode where SDK retries automatically on fallback without surfacing an error, and an option to surface the X-Redwood-Routed header to the app. Default: do not expose by default for user simplicity.

Otto (eng-runtime): Security: disallow client-specified fallback variants unless explicitly allowed in account policy. Client hints should be *hints*, not directives. We must encode that in header naming (e.g., hint_ prefix) to reduce expectation mismatch.

Maya (eng-platform): Good point. New naming suggestion: X-Redwood-Hint (not Route) and X-Redwood-Debug for debug-only flags. Example:
```
X-Redwood-Hint: region=eu-west-1;tier=preferred;variant_hint=quant8
X-Redwood-Debug: trace=route
```
Runtime will ignore or clamp fields as policy requires.

Jin (eng-telemetry): We'll map hint_* keys into route.hint_* telemetry fields. Also emit a boolean route.hint_used if a hint influenced the final decision.

Zara (product): On rollout UX — when we A/B a new variant, console should let us mark it as 'prefer but don't force' so customers with hint=tier=enterprise still get fallback protections. Console rollout UI should also surface the percent of requests that used a hint vs were overridden.

Eli (devex): Backwards compatibility: older SDKs might send X-Redwood-Route. Runtime should accept both but log a deprecation metric. We'll publish migration doc and SDK helpers.

Maya (eng-platform): Action items:
- Otto: add header parser that accepts both X-Redwood-Route (legacy) and X-Redwood-Hint (preferred) + response header X-Redwood-Routed. (ETA: next sprint)
- Jin: add telemetry fields (route.hint_region, route.hint_used, route.fallback_reason, route.penalty_ms) and short retention path for trace-enabled requests. (ETA: 2 weeks)
- Eli: SDK patch to expose regionHint/tierHint enums + map to header + helper to expose routed header. (ETA: 1 week)
- Zara: update console mockups for hint usage badge and fallback drilldown. (ETA: next week)

ops-bot: Maya scheduled a meeting "Routing hints: header contract" for 2026-03-19 15:00 UTC.

Otto (eng-runtime): I'll follow up with a minimal parser PR and some unit tests showing clamping behavior.

Maya (eng-platform): Thanks all — will capture notes into the spec doc and link in the meeting invite.

Eli (devex): Quick q: for the enum values we agreed on, will SDKs validate against account_tiers list? If not available offline, SDK should fallback to sending 'preferred' and let server clamp.

Maya (eng-platform): Yes, SDKs should not hard-fail if they can't validate; send as hint and server handles enforcement.

Jin (eng-telemetry): FYI I'll add a metric route.hint_clamped_count so PMs can see how often customers try to request higher-than-entitled tiers.

Zara (product): Perfect. Catch up in the meeting and I'll bring console mocks. :white_check_mark:
